responsibility: This file implements PRU target-specific front-end pragmas and address-space registration. Its main job is parsing #pragma CTABLE_ENTRY directives, validating CTABLE indices and base addresses, filling the global pru_ctable table used later for LBCO/SBCO-based constant-table addressing, issuing related diagnostics, and registering the __regio_symbol address space for accesses to the PRU I/O-register region.
